io.jahresabschluss.description_en: German bookkeeping: invoices, bank, receipts, fixed assets, EÜR, tax filing prep, annual reports
io.jahresabschluss.auth: OAuth 2.0: authorization code with PKCE and dynamic client registration; scopes read, write, send; no refresh token, reconnect when access expires. An unauthenticated request gets 401 with the metadata address https://jahresabschluss.io/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp. Alternatively a per-company API key as bearer token ('Authorization: Bearer jab_live_…'), created in the app under 'KI-Agent & API'.
